# apple_subscription_grace_period (Resource)

Sets an app's Billing Grace Period: how long subscribers keep access while App Store Connect retries a failed renewal payment. Every app has one setting, so this resource manages it, and destroying the resource leaves it. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_grace_period" "app" {
  app_id       = data.apple_app.example.id
  opt_in       = true
  duration     = "SIXTEEN_DAYS"
  renewal_type = "ALL_RENEWALS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `opt_in` (Boolean) Whether the grace period is on.

### Optional

- `duration` (String) Length of the grace period: `THREE_DAYS`, `SIXTEEN_DAYS`, `TWENTY_EIGHT_DAYS`.
- `renewal_type` (String) Renewals the grace period applies to: `ALL_RENEWALS`, `PAID_TO_PAID_ONLY`.
- `sandbox_opt_in` (Boolean) Whether the grace period is on in the sandbox.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the grace period setting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_grace_period.app
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_grace_period.app 1234567890
```
